about: Get ready for a pop-culture action adventure like no other!
Funko Fusion is a fast-paced third-person action game from 10:10 Games, bringing together iconic characters and worlds from your favourite franchises, all reimagined in signature Funko Pop! style.

Fight your way through handcrafted levels inspired by Jurassic World, Back to the Future, JAWS, The Thing, Chucky, Battlestar Galactica, Hot Fuzz, The Umbrella Academy, Five Nights at Freddy’s, Masters of the Universe, Invincible, and more. Each world is packed with secrets, collectibles, and fan-favourite moments.
Unlock and switch between over 60 playable characters from more than 20 franchises, each with their own abilities, weapons, and playstyle.
Combine ranged and melee combat with gadgets, abilities, and puzzle-solving to progress through each world and uncover hidden content.
Team up online with up to four players and experience the adventure together.
Step into a crossover built for fans and experience your favourite worlds in a whole new way!
summary: Funko Fusion is a fast-paced third-person action game from 10:10 Games, bringing together iconic characters and worlds from your favourite franchises, all reimagined in signature Funko Pop! style.
